lines.zh: 爪子落地，几乎没有声音
lines.en: My claws touch down almost silently.

lines.zh: 我贴着灌木走，风替我遮
lines.en: I hug the brush; the wind covers me.
Short steps, quick, without rustling.
My shadow arrives before I do.
Three toes cross dead leaves lightly.
Body low, tail held level.
I slip from one thicket to the next.
My prints in the damp soil stay shallow.
Around the stone; make no sound.
I move slowly, as if listening.
My tail brushes the low branches aside.
A little closer, a little quieter.
My legs tighten and I add half a stride.
I follow an old game trail.

lines.zh: 我歪头，听林子里谁在动
lines.en: Head tilted, I listen for movement.

lines.zh: 不动的时候，我才像石头
lines.en: Standing still, I resemble a stone.
The sound in my throat comes out very soft.
I stare at the same leaf for a while.
The wind parts my scales; I squint.
I will not call; a call gives me away.
My foreclaw scrapes the dirt once.
My tail swings slowly, keeping time.
This place smells used, from yesterday.
I crouch with my belly to the soil.
I press down the impatience in my bones.
The light is warm; I cannot be bothered.
I wait for one wrong step.
My eye flicks left, then back.
I look up, only at your hands.
You stand too upright.
I tilt my head and measure your height.
Between us there is only one path.

lines.zh: 你的影子压到了我的爪
lines.en: Your shadow falls on my claw.
I do not blink; neither should you.
That sack—is it meat?
You step back once. Noted.
I lower my head and show my teeth.
Standing like that, you resemble prey.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩断了一根枝
lines.en: Your boot snapped a twig.
I watch you, not your weapon.
Your breathing changed; I hear it.
I shift half a step for a better angle.
Do not reach out; hands look like food.
Let us just hold here a while.
I hiss and dart aside.
A patch of scales peels back.
Not fatal; I will remember it.
I recoil into a tree trunk.
You landed it. I admit that.
I growl, still very quietly.
Blood on my claw makes it slick.
I arch my back, ready to counter.

lines.zh: 疼让我更谨慎，不是更怕
lines.en: Pain makes me careful, not afraid.
You should have struck again. A pity.
Raw meat—I know that smell.

lines.zh: 你晃那块肉，我跟着晃头
lines.en: You wave the meat; my head follows.
I am not hungry, but I want it.
Put it down, step back, look away.
One bite is enough; I am not greedy.

lines.zh: 它比你的手更值得信任
lines.en: It is more trustworthy than your hand.
I stretch my neck, then pull back.
The meat sways; so does my patience.
I will circle it three times before eating.
Even a cunning hunter can be fed.
We collide; I spring away at once.
My shoulder bone is harder than yours.

lines.zh: 这一下撞掉了我半口气
lines.en: That knocked half my breath out.
I turn and my claw scrapes you.
You struck me from behind—foolish.
We are crowded into one narrow path.
I growl and give half a step.
My scales rasp across your hide.
After the bump I look for an angle.
Not so close; I cannot see.
One low call serves as an answer.
We walk side by side, then in file.
Tail touches tail; nothing more needed.
Between kin, scent speaks first.
I will not contest it; it is yours.
Two quiet calls merge into one.
The nest is up the slope; follow.
We take turns guarding this grass.
Pairing takes caution, not strength.
Close enough is enough.
I snatch it up and shake it twice.
This bone goes to my collection.
One hooked claw and it is mine.

lines.zh: 掉的东西，掉了就是我的
lines.en: Dropped is dropped; now it is mine.
I pin it beneath my foreclaw.
Sniff first, then decide.

lines.zh: 这玩意儿太硬，我咬不动
lines.en: Too hard; my teeth will not take it.
I carry it back into the grass.
A small thing, good for claw practice.
Hide it before the others notice.
The scent matches, so I pick you.
No call. I simply move.
The scent matches; begin.

lines.zh: 你转身的时候，我已经在动
lines.en: You turned, and I was already moving.
I have practiced this bite many times.
From the flank, never the front.
You stood too near the brush.
The body wakes first; the sound comes after.
I fix on the back of your knee.

lines.zh: 比迅猛龙更狠的那个，是我
lines.en: I am the one crueler than a raptor.
I've walked this game trail a thousand times.
One step, two—close enough.
I crouch, ready to spring.
Your scent is easy to find.
Still here, at your flank.
Run; I take the shortcut.
I am patient; I wait for fatigue.
Round the tree—my turn is quicker.

lines.zh: 你数着脚步，我数着间隙
lines.en: You count steps; I count openings.

lines.zh: 草丛替我挡了半边身子
lines.en: The grass hides half of me.
One bite missed—a mere test.
Your shield stance is stiff.
I hug the ground where you cannot see.
One more loop and you will falter.
My breathing stays shallow.
You wait for my call; I have none.
Three steps separate us.
I tread the edge of your shadow.
A cunning hunter never runs straight.
Claws first, teeth after.
This bite aims for your leg.
I leap and land at your side.
I tear one open wound.
I kick up dirt into your eyes.
I bite down and twist my shoulder.
Did you hear me exhale?
From this angle you cannot block.
I withdraw my claws and step back.
A crack—yours, not mine.
I do not stop; three bites in a row.
My tail whips across your ankles.
This hurts far more than a raptor's bite.
I taste blood, and I stay.
I rise out of the ferns.

lines.zh: 雾散了一点，露出我的牙
lines.en: The mist thins and shows my teeth.
The field is quiet, and here I am.
My claws grip the mud first.
This is a new hunting ground.
I lift my head and test the air.

lines.zh: 脚印从深处一直通到这里
lines.en: Footprints run from the deep places to here.
One low call claims the ground.
The trunk still drips; I wait.
My bones feel stiff; I stretch them out.
Who emptied this forest?
I will walk the border first.
My shadow lengthens on the ground.
No pack, only me.

lines.zh: 我把爪子插进土里，试了试
lines.en: I drive a claw into the soil and test it.
Let me see what has come.

lines.zh: 喉咙里那声，只有我自己听见
lines.en: That sound in my throat is mine alone.
I stand and lift my tail.
Flame scorches my scales; the stink is sharp.

lines.zh: 我落地没卸好力，腿一软
lines.en: I land badly and my legs buckle.

lines.zh: 水灌进肺里，我挣着上游
lines.en: Water fills my lungs; I kick upward.
The blast flips me over.
An arrow sinks behind my shoulder.
That force crawls along my bones.
Hunger whites out my sight.
Lightning runs down my spine.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我抓不到任何东西
lines.en: Nothing underfoot; nothing to claw.
